transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, let's conduct our transport-board huddle as per routine. I need the transportation, medical, signal, and engineer representatives to report any load or vehicle-control requirements for today's four moves: clinic cold-storage cases to the medical annex, communications mast to the north relay point, generator to the engineering yard, and routine administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse. Please speak up with any constraints or special requirements so I can match the right vehicle to each move.
